source.branch: During the first conflict turn with two adjacent Purple Worms, one Purple Worm’s AT_BITE hits the hero, then its AT_ENGL/AD_DGST attack roll succeeds. C reaches mhitu.c:mattacku() with foundyou true and calls gulpmu(); gulpmu performs the initial swallow, sets u.uswallow and calculates the AD_DGST digestion timer. The JavaScript mattacku slice currently admits only ice-vortex AD_COLD and Juiblex AD_DISE engulfing attacks, so it refuses the Purple Worm before dispatching gulpmu().
callers: mhitu.c:mattacku() AT_ENGL branch (844-856) calls gulpmu() after the successful hero-targeted engulfing roll; js/mhitu.js has the existing partial caller branch at 1256-1284.
mhitu.c:gulp_blnd_check() (1273-1284) is gulpmu()’s second direct caller; js/mhitu.js:2591-2610 currently records the gulpmu gap in this caller.
monmove.c:dochug() (965-972) is the ordinary monster action path into mattacku(); the assigned recording enters it during the hero’s turn-wait commands.
No mhitm.c:mattackm()/gulpmm() branch is reached before this first stop; the saved C action trace only records mattacku(), hitmu(), and gulpmu().

mon.c:remove_monster(), place_monster(), and set_ustuck() perform the initial swallow placement and attachment.
mhitu.c:mdamageu(), expels(), and stop_occupation() handle digestion damage, lifesaving, expulsion, and interruption of occupations.
light.c:snuff_lit() is called for inventory objects with its void result discarded; js/mhitu.js currently records note_unported("light.c snuff_lit") at that call site.
